title: A 15-Foot Shark Stayed Unknown Until a Navy Ship Snagged It

scenes.text: A 15-foot shark lived in our oceans, and nobody knew it existed.
Then in November 1976, a U.S. Navy research ship dropped its sea anchor off Hawaii.
Something huge got tangled in it, about 500 feet down.
It was a shark about 15 feet long with an enormous mouth, a species no one had ever described.
They named it megamouth. It swims with its mouth open, filtering krill and jellyfish.
Fewer than 300 have ever been caught or seen. The ocean still hides sharks as long as a car.

description:
Nobody knew megamouth sharks existed until one tangled in a Navy research ship's sea anchor off Hawaii in 1976.
It was about 15 feet long and filter-feeds like a whale shark.
What do you think is still hiding in the deep ocean?
